text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also powers translation tools, so people can quickly change text from one language into another. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where computers study messages to find out if people feel happy, angry, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with users in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily life with technology is becoming easier and more helpful.
